title: Standard Notifications/Alerts that sound only ONCE
symptom: The user reports that when an alert fires, it sounds repeatedly and is difficult to silence, requiring multiple steps (unlock phone, open app, click menu, select snooze alert, select snooze duration). They want an option for the alert to sound only once, or to choose how many times it plays before automatically silencing.
evidence_quote: I would like to hear that alert, but I don't want to hear it forever.
